items.title: Higher prevalence of rising climate-driven snowmelt potential of rain-on-snow events in the Eastern continental US
items.title_en: Higher prevalence of rising climate-driven snowmelt potential of rain-on-snow events in the Eastern continental US
items.title_zh: 美国东部大陆地区受气候变化驱动的“雨落雪上”事件融雪风险呈上升趋势，且发生率更高
items.summary_en: Rain-on-snow (ROS) events have significant hydro-geomorphological consequences. While these events have been widely studied, their meteorological capacity to thermodynamically alter or melt snow when unconstrained by snow amount, hereafter referred to as snowmelt potential (SMP), remains poorly understood, particularly with respect to its long-term trends. Here, we evaluate climate-driven trends in SMP, estimated as the snowmelt-inducing total surface energy flux transferred during ROS events assuming unlimited snow availability, across 8 991 sites in snow-affected regions of the continental United States over a 39-year period (1981–2019). Overall, SMP exhibits an increasing trend at ∼63% of the sites with the proportion of sites showing positive trends rising from 54.4% in the Western region, to 64.6% in the Central region, and 78.4% in the Northeastern United States. The spatial pattern of SMP trends remains robust to uncertainties arising from omitted radiative fluxes and dampened wind-speed trends. High-energy ROS events are found increasing at majority of stations, with the positive trends becoming more widespread as the energy threshold rises. SMP trends are primarily governed by changes in net radiation and sensible heat flux, modulated in large part by trends of event air temperature and wind speed. Findings suggest growing meteorological hazard potential from ROS events, especially at high-SMP sites, highlighting increased risk with continued climate warming.
items.summary_zh: 雨落雪（ROS）事件会产生重大的水文地貌学影响。 尽管此类事件已受到广泛研究，但当不受积雪量限制时，其从热力学角度改变或融化积雪的气象能力（下文称为融雪潜力，SMP）仍知之甚少，尤其是其长期趋势。 在此，我们评估了 SMP 的气候驱动趋势，该指标被估算为在 ROS 事件期间（假设积雪量无限）传递的、诱发融雪的总地表能量通量，评估范围涵盖美国大陆受积雪影响地区的 8 991 个观测点，时间跨度为 39 年（1981–2019）。 总体而言，约63%的观测点显示SMP呈上升趋势，其中呈现正趋势的观测点比例从西部地区的54.4%上升至中部地区的64.6%，并在美国东北部达到78.4%。 SMP趋势的空间分布模式在排除辐射通量和风速趋势衰减带来的不确定性后仍保持稳健。研究发现，在大多数观测站，高能ROS事件呈增加趋势，且随着能量阈值的升高，这种正向趋势的分布范围也愈发广泛。 SMP趋势主要受净辐射和显热通量变化的影响，并在很大程度上受到事件期间气温和风速趋势的调节。研究结果表明，ROS事件带来的气象灾害风险正在增加，特别是在SMP值较高的观测站，这凸显了随着气候持续变暖，相关风险也在加剧。

items.title: Biodiversity conservation and its associations with economic performance, inequality, and peace
items.title_en: Biodiversity conservation and its associations with economic performance, inequality, and peace
items.title_zh: 生物多样性保护及其与经济表现、不平等和和平之间的关联
items.summary_en: Biodiversity conservation is increasingly recognized as a product of coupled social–ecological systems shaped not only by ecological processes, but also by economic capacity, social inequality, and geopolitical stability. Here, we examined whether national conservation performance is systematically associated with economic prosperity, income inequality, peace, and the importance of natural resources in the national economy across 142 countries. Conservation performance was represented using the Nature Conservation Index (NCI), a composite metric integrating biodiversity threats, land management, governance capacity, and future environmental trends. We analyzed relationships between NCI, Gross National Income per capita, the Gini coefficient, the National Peace Index, and the total nature resources rents using a generalized additive model that accounted for nonlinear relationships and income stratification. Together, these societal variables explained deviance of 52.2% for the NCI model. Economic prosperity was positively associated with NCI, although the relationship was nonlinear across income groups, suggesting that conservation capacity does not increase uniformly with development. Counter to commonly assumed relationships between inequality and biodiversity loss, income inequality showed a positive multivariate association with NCI scores. This result suggests that high national conservation performance can coexist with unequal social conditions, potentially reflecting centralized or exclusionary conservation systems that elevate institutional conservation metrics without necessarily improving equitable biodiversity outcomes. We also found that more peaceful countries consistently exhibited higher conservation performance, supporting the view that geopolitical stability provides enabling conditions for sustained conservation governance and institutional continuity. We further suggest that national conservation indices may partly capture governance capacity, reporting infrastructure, and political commitment rather than ecological condition alone, while telecoupled trade systems may allow wealthier nations to externalize environmental pressures beyond their borders. Although the cross-sectional design precludes causal inference, our findings highlight the need to interpret global conservation indicators cautiously and to incorporate social equity and externalized environmental impacts more explicitly into international biodiversity assessment frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 生物多样性保护日益被视为社会-生态耦合系统的产物，其形成不仅受生态过程的影响，还受经济能力、社会不平等以及地缘政治稳定性的影响。 本文以142个国家为研究对象，探讨了国家保护绩效是否与经济繁荣、收入不平等、和平状况以及自然资源在国民经济中的重要性存在系统性关联。保护绩效通过“自然保护指数”（NCI）来衡量，该指数是一项综合指标，整合了生物多样性威胁、土地管理、治理能力以及未来环境趋势等因素。 我们采用广义加性模型（该模型考虑了非线性关系和收入分层），分析了NCI与人均国民总收入、基尼系数、国家和平指数以及自然资源租金总额之间的关系。这些社会变量共同解释了NCI模型中52.2%的变异量。 经济繁荣与NCI呈正相关，尽管这种关系在不同收入群体中呈现非线性特征，这表明保护能力并非随着发展而均匀提升。 与人们通常认为的不平等与生物多样性丧失之间的关系相反，收入不平等与国家保护指数（NCI）得分在多元分析中呈现正相关。这一结果表明，较高的国家保护绩效可以与不平等的社会状况并存，这可能反映出某些集中化或排他性的保护体系——这些体系虽提升了制度层面的保护指标，却未必能改善生物多样性保护的公平性。 我们还发现，更和平的国家普遍表现出更高的保护绩效，这支持了这样一种观点：地缘政治稳定为可持续的保护治理和制度连续性提供了有利条件。我们进一步认为，国家保护指数可能在一定程度上反映了治理能力、再
